mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses risk-free rates, reducing equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate investments.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase corporate profit margins through wage growth and reduced labor costs, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: Residential investment (RSAFS) exceeding $400 billion signals robust household demand for housing, which correlates with elevated consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS exceeds 400,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 indicates manufacturing sector contraction, which precedes corporate earnings slowdowns and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 95.0.

mechanism_narrative: Consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% annually signals persistent inflation, prompting delayed monetary easing and increasing recession risk, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% and rise in residential investment above $400 billion signals coordinated labor and housing market strength, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through aggregate demand expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when both UNRATE is below 4.5 and RSAFS exceeds 400,000 million.

mechanism_narrative: Non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 200,000 per month signals robust job creation that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rise in housing starts above 800,000 units and decline in industrial production below 95.0 indicates housing-led economic shift, which correlates with positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days through sector rotation.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST exceeds 800 and INDPRO is below 95.0.
